verdict.reasons: The candidate clearly features the single authorized AFP white-and-blue cylindrical drip-tape carton roll in a wheat crop setting. The branding 'AFP' and 'Drip Irrigation Tape' are legible and authentic, and the required watermark is present. Technical evidence shows installed flattened drip-tape laterals running between the wheat rows, aligning with the agrometry article. Minor cropping in the detail views is advisory only; all core conditions hold with excellent visual coherence.

focused_physical_review.reason: A black irrigation line runs directly into and disappears behind the base of the AFP package, establishing a contact. A broad, uninterrupted soil gap does not exist around the complete footprint of the package due to this physical intersection with the line. No distinct, additional loose uninstalled coils are visible, and no protruding ribbons, straps, or tape tails are emerging from the package body.
